correctness.rationale: For r>0 the natural spline curvature system has determinant (r+2)(3r+2)>0. Explicit cardinal function formulas establish exact sign patterns on each cell; the outer and central maxima are O(r) and C(r), respectively. O strictly decreases and C strictly increases; they meet uniquely at 9 sqrt(3) r^3=8(r+1). The exact sympy verifier checks cardinal expressions, derivatives, crossing, and 456 rational reconstructions. It does not replace the analytic proof. The range-escape factor follows algebraically from constant reproduction.

value.rationale: The four-node natural cubic is the first C2 cubic with two coupled interior curvatures. The sharp Lebesgue constant is a directly motivated nodal-noise stability quantity and determines exact [0,1]-range overshoot. A unique near-uniform minimax grid balances two independent spatial worst cases, and the variation-optimal symmetric natural-spline grid from published work has a substantially worse uniform noise norm (1.4871 versus 1.3044). The roughly 0.27% improvement over exact equal spacing is modest; exact structural separation of metrics and complete minimax within the symmetric class provide the substantive motivation, without claiming impact on arbitrary stencils.
